summary: Tested Delivery Ratings on the backend and the frontend (375x667, preview URL). Backend: 18/18 pytest pass. (1) The store ratings endpoint works for mer-1, returns 403 for mer-2 and 401 without a login. (2) Admin ratings return 200 for the admin and 403/403/401 for a store, a driver and no login, with the star split summing to count. (3) A rating with a comment is trimmed and capped at 300 characters, and stars=6 and a second rating both return 400. The comment then shows in the mer-1 recent list (with driver Marcus Reid), in the admin view (with shop Mission Bakery Co.) and in drv-1 feedback recent[].comment, and not in the mer-2 view. (4) /alerts/trends returns 200 and the screenshots zip returns 200 PK. Frontend: (1) /customer/TS9902: unlocking with 0172 shows rating-prompt with 44x44 stars. Tapping a star shows rating-comment-input, which caps at 300 characters (300/300 counter). Submitting shows rating-thanks and the 'THANKS FOR YOUR FEEDBACK' toast, and the comment was saved in the DB. (2) /merchant/mer-1 shows ratings-card with 4.0★, the BY DRIVER Marcus Reid row and both TEST rows with comments. (3) /admin shows 'CUSTOMER RATINGS · ALL STORES' with ratings-avg 4.2★, 3 driver rows and 30 recent rows. (4) /driver/summary/drv-1 shows 3 driver-feedback-comment entries. No page errors. One backend bug was reproduced: free-text comments leak into the /alerts/trends top_reasons.

minor.issue: When a low rating has no tags, routes/feedback.py:184 falls back to (st.rating_comment or '').split(','), so free-text customer comments become 'reasons'. Reproduced: a 1-star rating with no tags and the comment 'parcel was soaked, driver never knocked' produced top_reasons 'TEST_ PARCEL WAS SOAKED' and 'DRIVER NEVER KNOCKED'. Existing data already shows 'PARCEL CAME LATER THAN THE WINDOW. DRIVER WAS POLITE THOUGH.' as a drv-1 reason. This is noisy and may expose PHI-like free text in admin trends.
ratings_summary uses to_list(2000), so count, avg and the star split silently stop at 2000 ratings. Use a Mongo aggregation for the totals.

issues: rated_at uses fmtDepotTime, which shows only HH:MM (e.g. '11:46') with no date. Older ratings (e.g. MD1002 from the 29th) can't be told apart from today's. Use a day label plus the time, like DriverFeedbackCard does with dayLabel.
The ratings card lists all 30 recent ratings inline on the dashboard, which makes the page very long on mobile. Consider showing 5 with a 'SEE ALL' button.

action_items: routes/feedback.py:184 alert_trends: use only st.rating_tags for reasons. Drop the rating_comment split fallback, or apply it only when the comment exactly matches known RATING_TAGS (legacy data), so free-text comments never appear as top_reasons.
RatingsCard: show the date and time for rated_at (e.g. dayLabel + HH:MM) instead of only fmtDepotTime.
Optional: compute the ratings_summary totals with an aggregation instead of to_list(2000).
critical_code_review_comments: DriverFeedbackCard's docstring and the feedback endpoint say 'no patient details', but drivers now see raw free-text comments, which can contain names, addresses or health info. Consider a privacy note or basic redaction (this is a product decision).
RatingPrompt: the comment box uses maxLength=300 and the server also trims and caps at 300. Both are good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18). 1 minor bug outside the suite (trends comment leak)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ clones of MH2096 (TS9901, TS9902 and TS9903; merchant mer-1, route H-1023 drv-1, delivered now, last4 0172), rated them, and deleted them by id afterwards. MH2088 and MH2096 were not touched (both still unrated). No shout-outs were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && python tests/ui_seed_ratings_iter66.py seed && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests/test_delivery_ratings_iter66.py -p no:xdist -o addopts='' ; python tests/ui_seed_ratings_iter66.py cleanup. mer-1 has no real ratings (its 3 stops are pending), so ratings-empty shows unless you seed. The ratings feature uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env has no EXPO_BACKEND_URL key).
rca_of_issue: Trends leak: alert_trends iterates `st.rating_tags or (st.rating_comment or '').split(',')`. Before this iteration, rating_comment held comma-joined tags. Now it holds free text, so whenever a low rating has no tags the comment is split on commas and uppercased into reasons. Repro: tests/repro_iter66_trends_comment_reasons.py.
